units.source_text: 夏天，在海边租赁了一间别墅，

en.t: One summer, we rented a villa by the sea,

units.source_text: 我在别墅井边洗一家人的游泳衣的时候，

en.t: and while I was washing the family's swimsuits beside the villa's well,

units.source_text: 忽然听见小弟弟的呼喊声，

en.t: I suddenly heard my little brother calling out,

units.source_text: 看到小弟弟在波涛之中扬起的一只手、船帆、骤雨和翻腾的浪涛。

en.t: and saw one of his hands raised amid the waves, a sail, a sudden shower, and the surging breakers.

units.source_text: 我不禁愕然，抬起了脸，只见是个大晴天。

en.t: Startled in spite of myself, I lifted my face, only to see that the sky was perfectly clear.

units.source_text: 我还是急忙飞跑回家，告诉母亲说：弟弟可了不得啦！

en.t: Even so, I hurriedly ran back home and told my mother, My brother is in terrible danger!
